An easy way to test if the plugins are causing issues is to turn them all off in the Plugin Manager and see if the same thing happens. If it doesn't, you can then turn the plugins on one by one to narrow down which one causes it.

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body: On your transfer event from the bedroom to the hallway try Erase picture 1 and see if that helps since pictures do not erase on map transfer.

Where do I put "Erase picture 1"? On the event for the hallway? Thanks!!
NEVERMIND I FIGURED WHERE TO PUT IT! thanks you so much!!! Now it works thank you thank you!!!

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body: On your transfer events from one map to the next. If you're showing pictures that don't need to be shown on the next map, erase them on transfer.
